description: A trigger-driven stereo ducker: each trigger drops the level and lets it climb back along one of four fixed curves, for sidechain pumping without a detector.

params.text: Steps through the four gain curves, one per press.
Fires the envelope by hand, exactly as a trigger arriving at the jack does.
Crossfades between the untouched signal and the ducked one, 0 to 100% wet, and starts fully wet.

inputs.text: A rising edge past 1V fires the envelope, restarting it if one is already running.
The right channel in; with nothing patched here the left input is used for both.

outputs.text: The left channel out, ducked and crossfaded.
The right channel out, ducked and crossfaded.

notes: The four curves: a drop to about -30dB, 40ms hold, 280ms climb; the same hold with a 200ms climb that jumps late; a 350ms one-way fade to silence; a 20ms hold with a 140ms climb.
The third curve latches at silence. Once its fade has finished nothing comes out of the module until another trigger arrives.
The chosen curve is not saved with the patch. Reloading a patch returns the module to the first curve whatever was selected when it was saved.
Nothing here takes CV: the curves are fixed, and there is no threshold, ratio or attack control.

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left input.
